dropped.finding: The commit's stated motivating fix — Bedrock-hosted Claude regaining prompt caching / staying on PromptedOutput — is not reachable through the runner in production. Both runner call sites pass the model STRING `resolved` to `capabilities_for` (runner.py:346 and runner.py:605), so path 1 (`.profile` object) is never taken; the string path uses `_PROFILE_RESOLVERS`, which deliberately omits `bedrock`, and rebar's `_PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX`/`ProviderSession` register no bedrock prefix or builder. A `bedrock:` string (even if emitted) resolves to the conservative record (prompt_cache_style="none"), so `cache_settings_for` returns None and caching stays OFF — the exact defect this change claims to fix.
scenarios: A Bedrock-hosted Claude deployment expecting the caching/PromptedOutput fix described in the commit message
